name: Shobek
title: Descendant of Caleb
summary: Shobek (Hebrew: Shobek) is mentioned in the Bible as a descendant in Caleb's lineage through the tribe of Judah. He appears in the genealogical lists in 1 Chronicles as the son of Jahdai. The name also appears among those who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shobek is listed as one of the sons of Jahdai in the genealogy of Caleb, who belonged to the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Lineage and Inheritance
keyEvents.description: The lineage of Shobek is connected to Caleb, the faithful spy who received his inheritance in the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The Name Shobek in Covenant Renewal
keyEvents.description: A man named Shobek was among the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah after returning from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shobek is part of the extensive genealogy of the tribe of Judah recorded in Chronicles, demonstrating God's faithfulness through generations.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Faithfulness as Background
keyEvents.description: Caleb's faithfulness as one of the twelve spies forms the basis for the significance of this lineage, including Shobek's place in history.
